svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Cut the channel to 1,160 mm and deburr both ends and all edges

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 6.6 mm holes through both flanges, 14.6 mm from the web, 79 and 1,029 mm from the bottom end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fits: slide over the sealed free edge of a side wall from 46 mm above the floor, web against the edge

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bolt through the panel's outer clip holes (125 and 1,075 mm up) with M6 A4 bolts, washers and nuts, hand tight

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the free edge stays straight when the leaf is pressed lightly in the middle
